snippet.title: Dragon Blade 2 [ RPG Maker 2000 ] [ Hungarian ]
snippet.description:
Very low video quality ( T_T ) and Hungarian language!

The second part of my RPG Maker thrilogy :3

The story continues, new enemies and allies appear, new lands to discover, new skills to learn. 
And of course, the battle for the magical weapon -that nobody can use- has just started!

The game has own- graphics, drawings, CMS, CBS, and other little systems, all made by me ^^

Visit us at http://rubydragon.uw.hu (Hungary!!)
